question: What is the meaning of future function of the building in relation to end-of-life scenario?
description: The future function of the building in relation to end-of-life scenario refers to how the building will be used or repurposed at the end of its life. This could include reuse, recycling, or demolition, and is influenced by factors such as the building's condition, materials, and design. The concept is important in sustainable construction as it helps to minimize waste and maximize the reuse of building components.
